name: Global Summit on Biotechnology, Genomics & Bioengineering
tagline: Global Summit on Biotechnology, Genomics & Bioengineering
theme_primary: Engineering Tomorrow: Bioscience, Genomics, and the Future of Medicine
theme_blurb: Engineering Tomorrow: Bioscience, Genomics, and the Future of Medicine — convening the scientists, engineers and clinicians authoring the next decade of biotechnology.
hero_subtitle: An intimate two-day congress convening scientists, engineers and industry leaders at the forefront of biotechnology, genomics and bioengineering.
about_heading: Where biotechnology meets the next decade.
about_lead: GSBG 2027 is a global forum for pioneering research, clinical translation and cross-disciplinary dialogue across the full spectrum of biotechnology, genomics and bioengineering.
about_body: Across two days of keynotes, parallel technical tracks, poster sessions and focused workshops, we convene the brightest minds to chart the frontier of biotechnology — from laboratory science to clinical impact.
